list.title: Purchase Orders
list.subtitle: Order goods from suppliers, then receive and bill them.

create.title: New purchase order
create.subtitle: Draft an order; confirm it to start receiving goods.

confirmDialog.title: Confirm this order?
confirmDialog.body: The order becomes ready to receive and can no longer be edited.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel this order?
cancelDialog.body: The order will be marked cancelled.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this draft?
deleteDialog.body: This draft order will be removed. This cannot be undone.

receive.title: Receive goods — {{number}}
receive.subtitle: Enter the quantities received; stock moves in at cost.
receive.nothingOutstanding: Nothing left to receive on this order.

validation.noLines: Enter a received quantity for at least one line.

list.title: Vendor Bills
list.subtitle: Supplier invoices; confirming posts to the ledger.

create.title: New vendor bill
create.subtitle: Record a supplier invoice; confirm it to post the accounting entry.

confirmDialog.title: Confirm & post this bill?
confirmDialog.body: This posts the accounting entry (inventory/expense + input VAT vs. accounts payable) and cannot be undone.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this draft?
deleteDialog.body: This draft bill will be removed. This cannot be undone.
